decisions.title: Keep substring matching for mentions_target
decisions.rationale: The Target mention flag scenario says the flag is true when the title or rationale contains the path, basename or symbol; a word-boundary match would be stricter than the spec, so the literal containment rule stays and the reply tiers carry the residual uncertainty.

decisions.title: Worked example cites only what the trace carries
decisions.rationale: The supersession sentence asserted the superseding decision's content as Direct although the trace only carries its reference, and the decision-to-line claim was Direct without a reported mentions_target; both were rewritten so the example obeys the rules it teaches, and a test pins tag shape, claim count and the mentions_target premise.
